// pattern: Imperative Shell
These byte-identical, sanitized package assets are test inputs or post-computation assertions only.
The package manifest fixture remains shared with `f01e_provider`; boundary checks pin copied package,
receipt, and panner-trigonometry KAT assets to their approved manifests. The synthetic input hashes
are checked only after fresh recipe generation; they are not runtime inputs or seeds. No expected
output is a seed.
